en: Without a purpose, they wander... But many find their way back to the sacred areas that they once were sworn to protect.
Well, you're still here. I'd say that is something worth drinking to.
Lets go, $n. I am ready to reach Whitereach Post.
Channel your energies into the Altar!
** CONFIRMS TARGET LOCK. WAR RIDER UNIT INCOMING.  AERIAL ASSAULT IMMINENT. **
Where are the so-called heroes of this world?  Too frightened to come out and play?
What happened to our pigs?
What's needed for the cauldron at the Writhing Haunt?
I've been working on a way to transport oil underground between major cities, but everyone tells me it's a pipe dream.
Let's get a move on. My gear should be in the storage area up this way...
Amazing! How did you manage a permanent dominate?
The Dark Iron Dwarves shall reclaim their rightful lands!
FOOL! YOU ALLOWED THESE INSECTS TO RUN RAMPANT THROUGH THE HALLOWED CORE? AND NOW YOU LEAD THEM TO MY VERY LAIR? YOU HAVE FAILED ME, EXECUTUS! JUSTICE SHALL BE MET, INDEED!
Acquire high level data card.
%s rises from the soil!

I mean you no harm. I am scouting the quilboar and taking notes of their activities. My people have noticed something odd--an emanation or darkness--coming from this area. I've come to investigate, and what I've found is very disturbing.$B$BThere seems to be an undead diplomat who is powerful in the ways of the arcane. I don't believe he's one of the Forsaken... I think it's worse.
For Gnomeregan!

Hello again, $n!  It's good to see you!  Our Darkmoon Faire is quite a show, don't you think?$B$BThere is quite a lot to see!  So look!  Look, and perhaps, one day, even more will be revealed to you...
Take cover in the shadows. We have business to discuss once I finish showing these beasts why I am called the Hand of Chaos.
Hammertoe, you're as smart as you were stubborn in life and even in death. What can you tell me, ole friend?
My knowledge is limited, though I am still learning. It is time for you to move on, traveler. Find Josef Gregorian in Undercity and tell him you are ready.
Go report that the outpost is taken.  We will remain here.
They have you good on that one, lad!

Wushoolay, the Storm Witch.$B$BHer power is the power of the sky, the rain, and the shattered earth.  May she once again reign mother to the Gurubashi.  $B$BWushoolay now dwells far from here.  One day, she may return...
Ha! I'd take the sound of a Crater Cannon XT blasting off a shell over that any day!
If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.
I think you're more than qualified for this little assignment... let's see if I'm right!
Only a fool would dare disturb me in my lair.

The Scourge are establishing small staging points in the places under attack, receiving communications and other assistance from the necropolises that fly overhead. From what we can tell, the only way to root them out is by killing the ground forces that surround the points.
End our suffering!
Get away from me, monster!
The skinners usually take all their hides into Ironforge to dry out.  Why don't you head there and see if you can find one to train ye?
Are you sure that you are ready? If we do not have a group of your allies to aid us, we will surely fail.
Find Kaplak on top of the burrow in the southwest section of town.
Oh, thank you!  I have been trapped in this nightmare for so long...
I am forever denied the touch of stone.  I will never again know the glory of shaped iron...
I think I hear something! Chambers must be coming. Make way! Make way!
%s roars as his form shifts and he runs off.
I need another sparkling stone.
Hey $n!  Don't forget to grab a crate, a manual and a command stick!

Once you have built the device, you simply activate the device to be whisked away to lovely Gadgetzan!    Nearly everyone who has used the device has arrived on the pad here looking just the way they did when they began!

There have been some reported problems with transportees being replaced by their evil selves from an alternate universe, but I'm sure we will have that worked out soon...
What have you heard of the Shady Rest Inn?

If it is the way of the Warrior that you crave then you must seek out Krang Stonehoof.  You will find him in the southeast corner of the village at his training circle, often instructing his other students.
I've been expec...$B$B<Rimblat coughs.>$B$BExcuse me, old habit. I am Rimblat of the Earthen Ring.
They're going to show fireworks all night long.  From 6PM until dawn, the sky will blaze over Elune'ara!
I think not, I don't need to be blown up again.
This expedition is a terrible drain on military supplies.
Prepare yourselves, for we will soon launch an assault against they who called themselves "The Forsaken."
<It snaps its teeth together, chomping at its bit.>
Well done, Horde! We have enough Frostwolves in our stables to provide mounts to all of our wolf riders!

Wow! Looks like we already gathered all of the thick leather they think we'll need. That sure went by fast. You know, there are probably others around here that could use your help though if ya want to give 'em a hand.

Are you reporting for duty, $c? All of the war materiel for both the Horde and the Alliance is completed and being shipped to Silithus as we speak. It should all arrive in less than $2113w days. I hope that someone has found the different pieces of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands and put them all together.
Thanks to you, $n.
There... That should be enough rocks to make a necklace. I should probably get home now anyway.
